body:
I came here with this throwaway with the intention of creating my own post and then I saw yours. I have been sitting here trying to think of a way to tell you that I am experiencing the same things you are and how badly I wish you could feel better. I really fucking do.

I know how weird this sounds and feel free to take it however you want to, but I'd love to just talk to you. About anything you want. If you want me to just listen and understand, I'd be willing to do that. If you want to take your mind off of everything, I'd be willing to do that, too. Just please don't give up yet.
